model: DOAS Microprocessor Controller v6.2 (legacy points list)
equipment_type: Dedicated outdoor air system (DOAS) unit controller
applies_to: Greenheck dedicated outdoor air units running the older DOAS v6.2 controller program (July 2021 guide).
summary: This is the points list of Greenheck's DOAS controller at program v6.2, which uses different object numbering from the later DOAS programs (for example DOAS v9.4 and DOAS_10.006). It offers BACnet MS/TP, BACnet IP, Modbus RTU and Modbus TCP. The BMS can enable the unit, command occupancy, reset alarms, write setpoints, send sensor values and take over fans and the outdoor air damper through source-select points, with a watchdog. A long list of read-only binary values reports individual alarms, outputs and status.
notes: The table gives only BACnet object, Modbus register and a description; there is no object-name column, so the printed description is used as the name.
Access comes from the table's section headings: 'Write-Commandable' / 'Commandable' sections are shown commandable, 'No Write' sections read-only.
State texts come from the bracketed values in the descriptions (e.g. 1=Alarm; 0=Normal).
Object numbers differ from the current Greenheck DOAS BACnet integration guide (485940); use this list only for units on v6.2-era programs.
Engineering units are not printed in the table.
Source: points list, manual pages 41-48 (295 objects after removing repeated rows).

integration.summary: Enable the unit with BV 2 Master System Enable and command occupancy with BV 3, write the main temperature setpoint AV 1 and reset alarms with BV 4. Keep the BV 1 watchdog alive if the BMS sends sensor values or controls fans or the damper. Monitor unit status (AV 40), supply temperature, the general alarm BV 24 and the most recent alarm IV 7.

minimum_points.name: Main Temperature Setpoint - Supply, Space, or Return
BMS Watchdog Command
minimum_points.why: Heartbeat when BMS controls fans or sensors

integration.enable: BV 2 Master System Enable enables or disables the unit; BV 3 Occupancy Command sets occupancy (1 = Unoccupied).
integration.heartbeat: The BMS watchdog must be toggled by the BMS within the timeout delay whenever the BMS replaces a hardwired sensor. If the timer expires the controller alarms and falls back to its hardwired sensors until the BMS returns.
integration.remote_sensors: Set the sensor's source-select BV to BMS (1), then write the matching 'from BMS' AV; fans and the outdoor air damper are taken over the same way (e.g. BV-59 with AV-136 for the damper).
setup: BMS protocol and network settings are in the controller's Network Settings menu; save and reboot after changes.
gotchas: Shutdown alarms set System Enable false and keep the unit off until reset.
Numbering is not compatible with the later DOAS programs (v9.4, DOAS_10.006).
